manifest.scoring: The Gym writes stable per-target dispositions. Whether a result matches the registered mutation remains a separate, human-checkable step.

checks_run.label: Test material facts against the record
checks_run.description: Opponent tests only atomic, record-verifiable, material claims; Judge sustains a defect only when the supplied evidence and record coverage establish it.
checks_run.categoryDescription: Is the law right? Is the authority controlling? Are the required elements present, and does the record establish what the brief says it does?
checks_run.reason: No case materials are in scope for this session.

checks_run.label: Audit the elements of the rules invoked
checks_run.description: Detects the rules the brief cites or invokes by name, then audits each element of those rules: is it pleaded, and is it supported.
checks_run.categoryDescription: Is the law right? Is the authority controlling? Are the required elements present, and does the record establish what the brief says it does?

checks_run.label: Test cited authority support
checks_run.description: Whether each cited authority supports the material legal proposition for which the brief uses it.
checks_run.categoryDescription: Is the law right? Is the authority controlling? Are the required elements present, and does the record establish what the brief says it does?

checks_run.label: Opposing counsel, a judge, and a coach
checks_run.description: The core of the gym: opposing counsel makes the strongest arguments available against the brief, a judge weighs them, and a coach proposes answers.
checks_run.categoryDescription: Does the brief connect its rules to its facts? Does it work the difficult element instead of restating the rule? Does it confront adverse authority and answer the counterargument a court will think of on its own?
checks_run.reason: You turned this check off for this session.

checks_run.label: Issue framing
checks_run.description: Does the brief identify the real dispute early and frame it around the favorable legal question?
checks_run.categoryDescription: Not whether the brief is right, but whether it lands: how the question is framed, how the argument is ordered and emphasized, and whether a busy judge can follow it and believe it.
checks_run.reason: You turned this check off for this session.

checks_run.label: Macro-organization
checks_run.description: Are arguments ordered logically and by importance? Can the reader see the roadmap?
checks_run.categoryDescription: Not whether the brief is right, but whether it lands: how the question is framed, how the argument is ordered and emphasized, and whether a busy judge can follow it and believe it.
checks_run.reason: You turned this check off for this session.
